prompt.en-US: The last result was incomplete. Read the remaining content.

outcome.zh-CN: 读取已保存的工具结果和产物，按需查看完整内容。
outcome.en-US: Read saved tool results and artifacts to inspect their complete content.

documentation.zh-CN:
### 查看工具保存下来的完整结果

当对话里只展示摘要、结果过长，或你需要再次核对原文时，可以继续读取已经保存的产物。

提供结果中的资源地址，或说明要继续查看哪次操作。Agent 可以读取相关内容，再围绕问题整理重点，避免为了看完整结果而重复执行原工具。

产物可能包含文本、结构化结果和文件；具体读取范围由对应资源与工具契约决定。
documentation.en-US:
### Read the full saved result

Inspect stored artifacts when chat shows only a summary, a result is lengthy or the original output needs verification.

Provide a resource address or identify the earlier operation. Read relevant content without repeating the original action solely to recover its output. Artifacts may contain text, structured results and files; the resource and tool contracts define access.

description.zh-CN: 读取已保存的工具结果与任务产物。
description.en-US: Read saved tool results and task artifacts.
